summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly buyback transactions under its ongoing share repurchase program. Between June 11-17, 2026, the bank purchased 10,708,137 shares at average prices from €10.51 to €11.79 per share. Cumulative cash spent reached €3.38 billion, representing 67.1% of the program's maximum investment amount, and repurchasing ~17.2% of outstanding shares since 2021. The buyback, initially disclosed in February 2026, is authorized by the Board and conducted on Spanish (XMAD) and European (CEUX) exchanges. This is an ordinary capital return disclosure with no price, premium, or advisory details. What to watch/risk-arb angle: progress toward completion and potential impact on earnings per share.
